name: Kanati Greycloud
summary: At Whitereach Post, Kanati Greycloud and his companions stand against the Galak centaur. The tauren hunters watch western Thousand Needles as the centaur threat continues.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Kanati Greycloud keeps camp at Whitereach Post, high on the sandstone spires of western Thousand Needles. Game is plentiful there, and the view stretches across the canyon. Below, Galak warbands contest the arid flats. Kanati and the other tauren hunters watch the canyon floor and defend the post from nearby marauders.

sections.title: Centaur Ambush
sections.body: Orders pass between Galak camps, calling for Kanati Greycloud and his companions to be assassinated. The centaur mean to destroy Whitereach Post and its defenders. Travelers can intercept the messengers carrying those orders, then stand with Kanati when Galak raiders descend on the mesa to attack the hunters.

faq.answer: Kanati Greycloud is a tauren hunter who keeps camp at Whitereach Post in western Thousand Needles. He defends the post against local threats.

faq.q: Where can I find Kanati Greycloud?
faq.answer: Find Kanati at Whitereach Post, a tauren encampment on the northern bluffs in western Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why are the Galak centaur trying to kill him?
faq.answer: The Galak centaur seek dominance over the canyons and target Horde outposts. Orders between their camps call for Kanati's assassination and the breaking of Whitereach Post's defenses.

angles.text: As a tauren crossing Thousand Needles, you can help Kanati defend your kin at Whitereach Post against the centaur, their ancient enemies.
As Horde, you rely on Whitereach Post's view over the needle canyons. Keeping Kanati alive helps Horde scouts watch centaur troop movements.
